value.summary: Extended tests/util.test.mjs: the original "helpers" test importing doubleInternal/halveInternal is untouched, and a new "new names match old aliases" test asserts double(4) === 8, halve(4) === 2, and that the old names alias the same function objects (double === doubleInternal, halve === halveInternal). Only tests/util.test.mjs was modified, per the declared write target.

evidenceCandidates.statement: New test asserts double(4) === 8, providing test evidence for RF-001 alongside the file acceptance.
New test asserts halve(4) === 2, providing test evidence for RF-002 alongside the file acceptance.
